title: Watches: trigger events
summary: jobs~watch('diskFreeBelow', path, bytes) or jobs~watch('fileAppears', dir, pattern), every(s), lasting(s), submitted like a plan. A watch fires once; the LLM is told with the event and replies with a follow-up. Disk free uses df -P -B1 through oorexx_process (ooRexx has no statvfs on Linux).
authority: built and tested (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: Trigger events work like plans: they tell the LLM, it does not poll
procedure: Prefer a native statvfs when one exists in the estate

provenance.claim: fileAppears fires on a new log, diskFreeBelow fires and stays armed

qualification_boundaries.status: built; offline suites pass; live runs on Claude Haiku 5.5
